name: tweetId
label: Post ID
help: The X post (tweet) ID to retrieve.

name: tweetFields
label: Extra Post Fields
help: Optional X API tweet.fields expansions (e.g. created_at, public_metrics, attachments).

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency Key
help: Leave empty to treat an identical retry as the same operation. Set a new value to repeat an identical operation on purpose.
